note: Bilingual terms used on the site. The Arabic terms are the ones the site already uses; no native speaker has reviewed them. 'source' says where the English term is defined in this repository.

terms.definition: A public statement that an office will do something, possibly with a number and a date.
The list of commitments with their sources, checks and evidence.
A dated public document that reports progress against a commitment.
A public page or document from which a commitment or an evidence item was read.
How many of six checks the wording of a commitment passes.
What public evidence shows about progress; neutral when none is found.
Oversight, audit trail, UAE residency and fallback, as required by a definition.
A level from 0 to 4 for how far an AI use has been adopted.
Invented data made for the demonstration; never mixed with real numbers.
